raw.query: SELECT l.run_id, l.policy, l.forecast_model, l.quantile, l.p50_ms, l.p99_ms, c.gpu_hours FROM v_pool_latency l JOIN v_pool_cost c USING (run_id, pool, window_name, is_current) WHERE l.is_current = true AND l.experiment = 'planner' AND l.pool = 'language' AND l.window_name = 'aggregate' AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft';

raw.evidence: 651 ms is the p99 TTFT latency of the p90-forecast runs (not p50, which is ~22.65 ms); 518.6 GPU-h is the cost of the base p90-forecast run with null model, not a p50-forecast run (319.91 GPU-h) or runs with Toto (625.27 GPU-h), TimesFM (641.08 GPU-h), or reactive arms (281.79 GPU-h).
